def: TSMC's Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate packaging, which places a processor die and stacks of HBM side by side on an interposer to give the dense, short links HBM needs.
practice: Virtually all leading data-center GPUs are packaged this way, and from 2023 CoWoS capacity, together with HBM supply, was widely reported as the main limit on AI GPU output.
